# Template — Starter Premium Terms (Human Plan Review & Bankable Export)

> ⚠️ Template only, not legal/financial advice. Prices to validate with pilots.

**Service:** AgriSphere Starter Toolkit Premium — a human (agronomist/business adviser) reviews
your draft plan and returns a corrected, bankable version + a 45-minute consultation.

## What's included
1. Review of your generated draft: numbers sanity check, break-even & cash-flow corrections,
   market section strengthening, risk fixes.
2. One revision round and one 45-minute call/chat consultation.
3. Export pack: PDF + spreadsheet budget/records template + funding-application summary page.
4. 90-day follow-up check-in (one message) — plans live, not static.

## Price
- `[P …]` per plan (individual); `[P …]` per co-op/group plan (up to 5 enterprises);
- Discounted bundles for youth/women windows and group trainings `[X]%`.
- Free tier unchanged: self-service draft plan remains free forever.

## Honesty terms
- The premium service improves and reviews — it does **not** guarantee funding, profit or loan
  approval; no refunds on the basis of an unsuccessful application.
- All figures remain the starter's responsibility to verify with local quotes and the funder's
  current requirements.
- Reviewers do not take equity or commissions; referrals to funders are neutral.

## Delivery & disputes
- Delivery within `[10]` working days of payment; disputes handled by the maintainer within
  14 days; money-back if the review is not delivered at all.
